title: Students squeezed out of university courses after bumper A-level grades

paragraphs.en: Students across the UK have found themselves unexpectedly squeezed out of their desired university courses as this year’s bumper crop of A-level grades ​h​as not always translated into ​​the places many were hoping for.
paragraphs.zh: 全英国的学生发现，自己意外地被心仪的大学课程挤了出来，因为今年丰收般的 A-level 成绩并不总能转化为许多人期待的入学名额。

paragraphs.en: ​With close to a third of the A-levels awarded in England, Wales and Northern Ireland achieving the top A and A* grades this year, universities are taking a tougher stance by rejecting students who narrowly missed their expected grades and who in previous years would still have gained a place.
paragraphs.zh: 今年英格兰、威尔士和北爱尔兰的 A-level 成绩中，接近三分之一获得了最高的 A 和 A* 等级，这使得大学采取更强硬的立场，拒绝了那些以微弱差距未达到预期成绩、而在往年本可仍然获得名额的学生。

paragraphs.en: The stronger competition has tipped record numbers of applicants into clearing, or settling for their second choices, with universities in some cases wanting students to defer for a year.
paragraphs.zh: 更加激烈的竞争使创纪录数量的申请者落入补录程序（clearing），或不得不接受第二志愿，有些大学甚至希望学生延期一年入学。

paragraphs.en: Cardiff ​University ​h​as asked students on two programmes to defer until 2027, after more than expected achieved their required grades, leaving it with a surplus of qualified applicants for courses such as midwifery.​
paragraphs.zh: 在超过预期的学生达到所需成绩之后，卡迪夫大学（Cardiff University）已要求两个课程的学生延期至 2027 年入学，这使其在助产等课程上出现了合格申请者过剩的情况。

paragraphs.en: The university said it had asked “a small number” of applicants to defer, with limits on its intake previously agreed with the Welsh government.
paragraphs.zh: 该大学表示，已要求“少数”申请者延期，其招生名额限制此前已与威尔士政府达成一致。

paragraphs.en: “We understand this will be deeply disappointing for those affected, and our immediate priority is to support these students and ensure they receive clear guidance as they consider their next steps,” a spokesperson for Cardiff said.
paragraphs.zh: 卡迪夫大学的一位发言人表示：“我们理解这会让受影响的学生深感失望，我们的当务之急是支持这些学生，并确保他们在考虑下一步时获得明确的指引。”

paragraphs.en: “It is important to be clear that Cardiff University has not over-offered places. As with all universities, offers are made based on detailed modelling of applicant behaviour and historical acceptance patterns. This year, an exceptionally high number of applicants met the conditions of their offers and accepted places, resulting in demand exceeding the number of commissioned places available.
paragraphs.zh: “需要明确的是，卡迪夫大学并未超额发放录取名额。与所有大学一样，录取名额是基于对申请者行为的详细建模和历史录取模式来确定的。今年，达到录取条件并接受名额的申请者数量异常之高，导致需求超过了可提供的受资助名额。”

paragraphs.en: “This has been an extremely difficult decision … and we explored every possible option to avoid activating the university’s oversubscription policy for these two courses.”
paragraphs.zh: “这是一个极其艰难的决定……我们探索了所有可能的方案，以避免对这两门课程启用大学的超额录取政策。”
